result.question: What sign does the man of God give?

readings.answer: That the altar will be split apart and its ashes poured out.
readings.support: Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly states the sign: the altar will split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out, matching the key exactly.

result.reason: The text directly states the sign as the altar splitting and its ashes pouring out.
